_sections.build: Defines the dev server URL, build commands, and dist directory for the frontend

tauri.allowlist: Declares which Tauri APIs are accessible from the frontend (shell, window, clipboard, etc.)
tauri.bundle: Application bundle settings: identifier, icons, targets (deb, appimage, msi, dmg)

windows.alwaysOnTop: Set to true so the overlay stays above all other windows
windows.decorations: Set to false for a frameless window with no OS chrome
windows.label: Unique window identifier used in window_manager.rs
windows.resizable: Set to false to keep the overlay a fixed size
windows.title: Application window title
windows.transparent: Set to true to allow transparent background rendering
windows.url: Points to the frontend dev server or built index.html
windows.x: Initial X position of the overlay
windows.y: Initial Y position of the overlay
